summary: Tested Solo program bug fix and Exercise params/weight feature. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend pro-exercise-detail page fully functional with StatEditor +/- buttons and weight tracker.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing user with active program and assigned exercises
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features verified. User Josette has active solo program '21 jours pour mieux dormir' and assigned exercise 'Squat' (id=exercise-params) with equipment 'Barre'. Exercise params and weight tracking working correctly.

bug_solo_program_no_team.details: GET /api/programs/active returns team=null when enrollment mode is solo. Code at program_routes.py lines 322-326 correctly skips team lookup for solo mode.

backend_update_params.details: PUT /api/pro/assigned-exercises/{id}/update-params correctly updates sets, repetitions, rest_seconds. Verified persistence via GET.

backend_save_weight.details: PUT /api/pro/assigned-exercises/{id}/save-weight saves weight_kg and adds to weight_history. Returns 400 if weight_kg missing.

backend_exercise_detail.details: GET /api/pro/assigned-exercise-detail/{id} returns last_weight_kg and weight_history fields correctly.

frontend_stat_editor_buttons.details: StatEditor +/- buttons visible and functional for Series, Reps, Repos when mode=assigned. data-testid attributes present.

frontend_weight_tracker.details: Weight tracker section visible for exercises with equipment (Barre). Shows last session weight, input field, and save button.

frontend_save_params_button.details: Save params button ('Enregistrer les modifications') appears after changing values via +/- buttons.

frontend_weight_save_confirmation.details: Weight save button shows green 'OK' confirmation after successful save. Weight history displays correctly.

program_routes_lines_322-326.details: Team lookup correctly skipped for solo mode: if enrollment.get('mode') != 'solo': team = await db.team_programs.find_one(...)

program_routes_lines_436-439.details: Team activity emission correctly skipped for solo mode in save-task endpoint

professional_routes_lines_2133-2148.details: update-params endpoint correctly validates beneficiary ownership and updates sets/repetitions/rest_seconds

professional_routes_lines_2151-2174.details: save-weight endpoint correctly saves last_weight_kg and appends to weight_history array

pro-exercise-detail_tsx.details: Full rewrite with StatEditor component (lines 387-404) and weight tracker section (lines 214-270). All data-testid attributes present.
